verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares documents component pieces that together support this workflow: board/stockholder consent workflows integrated into platform actions (docs-14, docs-20), FMV-based (409A-informed) strike price setting including above/below FMV options (docs-5, docs-25), third-party 409A valuation integration (docs-16), and Gusto integration that can automatically grant equity from offer letter promises for new hires (docs-17, docs-18). However, no single doc demonstrates these steps chained into one seamless end-to-end workflow for a specific new-hire option grant. Missing for 10: an explicit walkthrough or independent case study showing the full connected flow (new hire onboarding → board approval → 409A strike price applied → grant issued) as one integrated process rather than separate features.
